data.notes:

In the Data center "Ciudad Digital", we provide 5.5 MW and certified redundant continuous generation plants, Data Center Tier III in Design, Energy available in the IT room.  In voltages of 120-208V or 48VDC with 5.8KW to 14.4KW capacities in each rack of 47U, with A and B vertical system, PAC: 2N+1,500 Kw/ 1,700.000 BTU (per IT room) high efficiency air conditioning system, with precision-controlled humidity and temperature ranges.
